$$
{\begin{aligned}x+z=4x+y+2 \\ x+y=2z+2 \\ y=x-y+z+1\end{aligned}
$$

Find the solution $x=[x,y,z]^{T}$ of the system by computing the inverse of the coefficient matrix.

feedback.problem:
Solve the following system of linear equations by finding the inverse of the coefficient matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2y+3z+x=-1 \\ 4z+y=1 \\ 5x+6y-3=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We organize the system so that it’s in the correct order first:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y+3z=-1 \\ y+4z=1 \\ 5x+6y=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

We wish to write this system in the form $Ax=b$, where $A$ is a $3\times 3$ matrix and $x$ and $b$ are $3\times 1$ column vectors. We can do this as follows:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 5 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, the solution to $Ax=b$ is given by $x={A}^{-1}b.$ So, we compute ${A}^{-1}$ as follows:

*Step 1:*

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 5 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =1|\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|-2|\begin{aligned}0 & 4 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}|+3|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =1(-24)-2(-20)+3(-5) \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 2:*

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}0 & 4 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & 6\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 5 & 6\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}|\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-24 & -20 & -5 \\ -18 & -15 & -4 \\ 5 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 3:*

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}-24 & 20 & -5 \\ 18 & -15 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 4:*

$$
{C}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}-24 & 18 & 5 \\ 20 & -15 & -4 \\ -5 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 5:*

$$
{A}^{-1}=\frac{1}{det(A)}{C}^{T}=\frac{1}{1}[\begin{aligned}-24 & 18 & 5 \\ 20 & -15 & -4 \\ -5 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Hence

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-24 & 18 & 5 \\ 20 & -15 & -4 \\ -5 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}42 \\ -35 \\ 9\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Hence the solution is $x=42,y=-35,z=9.$
